decisions.reason: The conferencing service has become a crowded commodity, but it remains a low-cost option with some enterprise demand, so the firm keeps it while it costs little.
Optical spectrum connectivity builds on the firm's core optical assets and serves growing data-centre and cloud needs, so this option retains high upside.
The voice-number portal is a cheap digital extension whose market potential is still not disproven, so it is worth keeping open.
Carrier pre-selection is a declining legacy service with little strategic upside, and results now show its value is unlikely to be realized.
